name: UK garage
blurb: A kick that skips a beat, shuffled hats and an organ bass.

sounds.name: 2-step drums
sounds.why: House drums with the second and fourth kicks taken out and one put back late. The beat seems to trip and catch itself, twice a bar.

ingredients.name: The skeleton
ingredients.adds: Kick on 1, snare on 2, a kick just after 3, snare on 4.

ingredients.name: The 909
ingredients.adds: The 909's tight kick and snappy snare.

ingredients.name: Sixteenth hats
ingredients.adds: Hats on every sixteenth, loud on the eighths and quiet between.

ingredients.name: Shuffle it hard
ingredients.adds: Every second sixteenth is pushed late, much further than in house.
ingredients.listenFor: The hats start to skip. This is the garage bounce.

knobs.below: Straight: it sounds like slow drum and bass.
knobs.above: The late hats collide with the next beat.

ingredients.name: Ghost snares
ingredients.adds: Quiet extra snares just before the main ones.

pitfalls: Putting the kick back on every beat turns it into house at once.

sounds.why: The house organ bass, carried over, but playing around the gaps the kick left.
The darker choice of bass: a plain sub that hits with the kick and then again where the kick is missing.

sounds.name: Vowel chop
sounds.why: Garage hooks are tiny slices of a singer, retuned and played like a keyboard. There are no vocal samples here, so a filter shaped like a mouth stands in for the voice.

ingredients.name: A sawtooth melody
ingredients.adds: A buzzy line with no voice in it.

ingredients.name: Give it a mouth
ingredients.adds: A filter that picks out the same frequencies as a sung "ah", "eh" or "oh".
ingredients.listenFor: The synth starts to say something.

ingredients.name: Chop it
ingredients.adds: Each note is cut short, like a slice of a longer word.

ingredients.name: Scoop into each note
ingredients.adds: Every note starts a little flat and slides up, as singers do.

ingredients.name: Echo
ingredients.adds: Repeats that fall in the gaps.

sounds.why: A soft minor seventh stab between the kicks, borrowed from house and played with the same shuffle.
Warm chords from soul and R&B, held behind the beat.
